//: Capability manifest for navbar/1 (the .pc-navbar shell container) — keen-pure-admin. See settings-panel.map.json / command-palette.map.json for the capability-only model. navbar/1 renders <nav class="pc-navbar {class}"> > <div id="pc-navbar-inner-{unique_integer}" class="pc-navbar__inner" phx-hook="PureAdminNavFit"> with conditional start/center/end zones. The NavFit hook needs a stable DOM id, so keen stamps a non-deterministic generated id on __inner that svelte attaches at runtime instead — the reason this fixture is capability-only (see navbar.json). The one shared SSR feature is the root class passthrough.
